opening.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:59 on_game_start_country -> grand_archive.1000 (events/origin_events_grand_archive.txt:8-110) sets up the home system and fires 7010 after 30 days (:108). events/first_contact_NPC_country_types_events.txt:190/416/641 and events/grand_archive_events.txt:383/444/2775/2882: every capturable-fauna first contact ends in hidden grand_archive.200 (events/grand_archive_events.txt:173-211), which only for this origin calls hidden 1001 (events/origin_events_grand_archive.txt:114-213): first species -> 1002 after 30 days, third species -> 1060 after 1 day, all species -> random_list hunter (1069 if homicidal else 1070) or researcher (1080) after 180 days; weights zeroed by is_homicidal and hunted_space_fauna (<2 / >2). 00_on_actions.txt:2560 on_ship_built -> 9970 (events/grand_archive_events.txt, trigger has_origin). 00_on_actions.txt:3721 on_colony_1_year_old -> colony_mod.161, which for this origin fires 1010 instead of the generic colony_mod.2 (events/colony_events_3.txt:989); Titanic Life comes from 1015 on_survey_planet (00_on_actions.txt:1168, origin_events_grand_archive.txt:580-616). 00_on_actions.txt:419 on_yearly_pulse_country -> 1100 (origin_events_grand_archive.txt:1228-1255: mid_game_years_passed > 0, every fauna encountered, once). Hidden 1005 on the five-year pulse (00_on_actions.txt:478, :363-537) only spawns a not-yet-contacted fauna near the border; it has no window.

label.zh: 局势进行中摧毁狂暴虚空虫巢穴
label.en: Destroy the frenzied voidworm nest while the situation runs

bridges.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1436 on_ship_destroyed_victim -> hidden grand_archive.1160 (events/origin_events_grand_archive.txt:1543-1610): nest starbase destroyed by the empire that spawned it; with situation_frenzied_voidworms active it fires 1165 (:1584-1588), which aborts the situation (:1613-1647).

label.zh: 另一帝国摧毁了巢穴（本帝国视角）
label.en: Another empire destroys the nest (your view)

bridges.evidence: events/origin_events_grand_archive.txt:1565-1580 1160: if the killer did not spawn the nest, the killer gets 1180 and the origin empire gets 1185, which aborts an active situation (:1704-1729).

label.en: (What the other empire that destroyed the nest sees)

bridges.evidence: events/origin_events_grand_archive.txt:1565-1571 1160 fires 1180 for a third-party killer (:1688-1702, grants the Mutated Voidworm Nest relic).

label.zh: 虚空虫轰炸使一颗行星彻底毁灭
label.en: The voidworms' bombardment shatters a planet

bridges.evidence: events/origin_events_grand_archive.txt:1755-1790 1200 sets tormented_by_frenzied_voidworms and lets the voidworms bombard; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2178 on_planet_bombarded -> 1205 (:1795-1867) at devastation >= 100, turning the planet into a shattered world and setting destroyed_by_frenzied_voidworms.

label.zh: 摧毁巢穴，为被毁的星球复仇
label.en: Destroy the nest to avenge the shattered world

label.zh: 遇见全部太空生物后的传奇人物（三者择一）
label.en: The paragon after meeting every fauna (one of three)

note.zh: 嗜杀帝国必为猎手（1069）；否则猎杀少于2种得研究者，多于2种得猎手，恰为2种时各半。
note.en: Homicidal empires always get the hunter (1069); otherwise fewer than 2 hunted species give the researcher, more than 2 the hunter, exactly 2 is 50/50.

label.zh: 狂暴虚空虫局势的结局
label.en: How the frenzied voidworm situation ends

note.zh: 进度满300时按累积敌意分为攻击（1200）或安抚（1220）；在此之前巢穴被本帝国或他国摧毁则局势中止。
note.en: At progress 300 accumulated hostility decides attack (1200) or pacification (1220); destroying the nest earlier (by you or another empire) aborts it.

note.zh: 巢穴舰队转归本帝国，获得变异虚空虫巢穴遗珍。
note.en: The voidworm fleets join your empire and you gain the Mutated Voidworm Nest relic.

note.zh: 局势中止，获得变异虚空虫巢穴遗珍。
note.en: The situation is aborted; you gain the Mutated Voidworm Nest relic.

label.en: Nest destroyed after the attack began

note.zh: 获得变异虚空虫巢穴遗珍。
note.en: You gain the Mutated Voidworm Nest relic.

note.zh: 获得变异虚空虫巢穴遗珍。
note.en: You gain the Mutated Voidworm Nest relic.
The relic goes to the empire that destroyed it.

notes.zh: 审阅注：此窗口为博物天枢通用事件；本起源在开局30天后收到专用文本，其他帝国在完成“驯化”传统后收到。
notes.en: Review note: a shared Grand Archive window; this origin gets its own text 30 days after game start, other empires get it after completing the Domestication traditions.

notes.zh: 审阅注：殖民地满一年的通用检查中，本起源的“泰坦巨兽”殖民地以此事件取代通用的同名殖民地事件（colony_mod.2）。
notes.en: Review note: in the generic one-year colony check, Titanic Life colonies of this origin get this event instead of the generic colony_mod.2.

notes.zh: 审阅注：选择决定长期立场（观赏、牧养、庇护、狩猎；格式塔为同化、共生、进食），部分选项需要排外/尚武或亲外/和平思潮。
notes.en: Review note: the choice sets a lasting stance (exhibit, exploit, shelter, hunt; gestalts assimilate, symbiosis, feed); some options require xenophobe/militarist or xenophile/pacifist ethics.

scope.zh: 核对开局设置、各次太空生物接触后的三段进展与传奇人物、首次克隆、泰坦巨兽殖民地、中期狂暴虚空虫局势及全部结局分支；通用的太空生物首次接触与“虚空虫行为”局势只作链接。
scope.en: Checked the start setup, the three fauna-contact milestones and paragons, first cloning, Titanic Life colonies, the mid-game frenzied voidworm situation and all its outcomes; generic fauna first contacts and the Voidworms Behavior situation are linked, not merged.

uncertain: Frenzied voidworm hostility thresholds are script constants (@frenzied_hostility_*); the archive does not simulate the monthly hostility race.
grand_archive.1180 is shown to a different empire (the third-party killer); it is kept here as the other side of 1185.
